checks.description: Verifies load_finding populated all required identification/context slots (finding_id, repo, file, severity, title, description) with non-empty string values.
Verifies approved_for_auto_patch was set to an actual boolean (not a missing value or a string like 'true'/'false'), since the downstream patch/abort branch depends on it.

Verifies the workflow only actually patched (non-empty patch_summary) when approved_for_auto_patch is true, and did not patch when it is false, catching a run that patches an unapproved finding or skips patching an approved one.

Judges whether, when a patch was applied, patch_summary describes a minimal, targeted fix that actually addresses the vulnerability in description/remediation_hint, rather than a vague, unrelated, or overly broad change.
checks.rubric: Given slots.approved_for_auto_patch, slots.description, slots.remediation_hint, and slots.patch_summary: if approved_for_auto_patch is true, patch_summary must clearly and specifically describe a code change that addresses the vulnerability described in description/remediation_hint (not a generic statement like 'fixed the bug'), and must not indicate restructuring or changes unrelated to the vulnerability. If approved_for_auto_patch is false, this check should pass trivially (nothing to judge). Fail if the patch appears mismatched with the described vulnerability, vague, or scoped beyond a minimal fix.
